```
" ============================================================================
" 行注释和取消注释函数 - 支持多种文件类型
" 快捷键: F3 注释, F4 取消注释
" ============================================================================

" 获取当前文件类型的注释符号
function! GetCommentSymbol()
    let filetype = &filetype
    
    if filetype == 'python'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'vim'
        return '"'
    elseif filetype == 'verilog'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'c' || filetype == 'cpp'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'javascript' || filetype == 'typescript'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'java'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'rust'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'go'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'sh' || filetype == 'bash'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'ruby'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'perl'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'lua'
        return '--'
    elseif filetype == 'sql'
        return '--'
    else
        " 默认使用 #
        return '#'
    endif
endfunction

" 添加行注释
function! CommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let current_line = getline('.')
    
    " 检查是否已经注释
    if current_line =~ '^\s*' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s'
        return
    endif
    
    " 获取缩进
    let indent = matchstr(current_line, '^\s*')
    let content = substitute(current_line, '^\s*', '', '')
    
    " 添加注释符号
    if comment == '//'
        call setline('.', indent . '// ' . content)
    else
        call setline('.', indent . comment . ' ' . content)
    endif
endfunction

" 取消行注释
function! UncommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let current_line = getline('.')
    
    " 构建注释前缀的正则表达式
    let comment_pattern = '^\(\s*\)' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s\?'
    
    " 检查并移除注释符号
    if current_line =~ comment_pattern
        let indent = substitute(current_line, comment_pattern, '\1', '')
        call setline('.', indent)
    endif
endfunction

" 快捷键映射
nnoremap <F3> :call CommentLine()<CR>
nnoremap <F4> :call UncommentLine()<CR>

" 可视模式下的快捷键（注释/取消注释多行）
vnoremap <F3> :call VisualCommentLine()<CR>
vnoremap <F4> :call VisualUncommentLine()<CR>

" 可视模式下注释函数
function! VisualCommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    " 获取选中的行范围
    let start_line = line("'<")
    let end_line = line("'>")
    
    for line_num in range(start_line, end_line)
        let current_line = getline(line_num)
        
        " 获取缩进
        let indent = matchstr(current_line, '^\s*')
        let content = substitute(current_line, '^\s*', '', '')
        
        " 跳过空行
        if empty(content)
            continue
        endif
        
        " 检查是否已经注释
        if current_line !~ '^\s*' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s'
            if comment == '//'
                call setline(line_num, indent . '// ' . content)
            else
                call setline(line_num, indent . comment . ' ' . content)
            endif
        endif
    endfor
endfunction

" 可视模式下取消注释函数
function! VisualUncommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let start_line = line("'<")
    let end_line = line("'>")
    
    let comment_pattern = '^\(\s*\)' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s\?'
    
    for line_num in range(start_line, end_line)
        let current_line = getline(line_num)
        
        if current_line =~ comment_pattern
            let indent = substitute(current_line, comment_pattern, '\1', '')
            call setline(line_num, indent)
        endif
    endfor
endfunction

" ============================================================================
" 使用说明:
" - 普通模式: 将这个文件source到你的gvimrc中
" - F3: 注释当前行或选中的多行
" - F4: 取消注释当前行或选中的多行
" - 支持的文件类型: python, vim, verilog, c, cpp, javascript, typescript,
"                    java, rust, go, sh, bash, ruby, perl, lua, sql 等
" ============================================================================

```

已为您创建了一个完整的 Vim 注释脚本文件。现在您需要将其加载到 gvimrc 中：

## 使用方法

在您的 **gvimrc** 文件中添加以下行（通常位置为 `~/.gvimrc` 或 `%APPDATA%\Vim\gvimrc`）：

```vim
" 加载行注释脚本
source c:/Users/man/Desktop/code/comment_toggle.vim
```

## 功能特性

| 快捷键 | 功能 |
|--------|------|
| **F3** | 注释当前行或选中的多行 |
| **F4** | 取消注释当前行或选中的多行 |

## 支持的文件类型和注释符号

| 文件类型 | 注释符号 |
|---------|---------|
| Python | `#` |
| Vimrc/Vim | `"` |
| Verilog | `//` |
| C/C++ | `//` |
| JavaScript/TypeScript | `//` |
| Java | `//` |
| Rust/Go | `//` |
| Shell/Bash | `#` |
| Ruby | `#` |
| Lua/SQL | `--` |

## 使用示例

```python
# Python 文件中
print("Hello")      # 按 F3 注释该行
# print("Hello")    # 再按 F4 取消注释

// Verilog 文件中
wire clk;           # 按 F3 注释该行
// wire clk;        # 再按 F4 取消注释
```

## 高级特性

- **保留缩进**：自动保留行的缩进级别
- **智能跳过**：空行不会被注释
- **可视模式**：选中多行后按 F3/F4 可一次性注释/取消注释所有行
- **避免重复**：已经注释的行再按 F3 不会重复注释

脚本已保存到 `comment_toggle.vim`，您可以随时修改或将其集成到您的 gvimrc 中使用！

<summary>Tool use: **read_file**</summary>

Read `comment_toggle.vim`, lines 55 to 120

**Input:**

```
endfunction

" Add line comment
function! CommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let current_line = getline('.')
    
    " Skip if already commented
    if current_line =~ '^\s*' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s'
        return
    endif
    
    " Preserve indentation
    let indent = matchstr(current_line, '^\s*')
    let content = substitute(current_line, '^\s*', '', '')
    
    " Insert comment symbol
    if comment == '//'
        call setline('.', indent . '// ' . content)
    else
        call setline('.', indent . comment . ' ' . content)
    endif
endfunction

" Remove line comment
function! UncommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let current_line = getline('.')
    
    " Build pattern to match comment prefix
    let comment_pattern = '^\(\s*\)' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s\?'
    
    " Strip comment symbol if found
    if current_line =~ comment_pattern
        let indent = substitute(current_line, comment_pattern, '\1', '')
        call setline('.', indent)
    endif
endfunction

" Key mappings
nnoremap <F3> :call CommentLine()<CR>
nnoremap <F4> :call UncommentLine()<CR>

" Visual mode mappings (comment/uncomment multiple lines)
vnoremap <F3> :call VisualCommentLine()<CR>
vnoremap <F4> :call VisualUncommentLine()<CR>

" Comment selected lines in visual mode
function! VisualCommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    " Get selected line range
    let start_line = line("'<")
    let end_line = line("'>")
    
    for line_num in range(start_line, end_line)
        let current_line = getline(line_num)
        
        " Preserve indentation
        let indent = matchstr(current_line, '^\s*')
        let content = substitute(current_line, '^\s*', '', '')
        
        " Skip empty lines
        if empty(content)
            continue
        endif
```

```
" Visual mode mappings (comment/uncomment multiple lines)
vnoremap <F3> :call VisualCommentLine()<CR>

" Comment selected lines in visual mode
function! VisualCommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    " Get selected line range
    let start_line = line("'<")
    let end_line = line("'>")
    
    for line_num in range(start_line, end_line)
        let current_line = getline(line_num)
        
        " Preserve indentation
        let indent = matchstr(current_line, '^\s*')
        let content = substitute(current_line, '^\s*', '', '')
        
        " Skip empty lines
        if empty(content)
            continue
        endif
```
